sentences.text: The house began to notice something strange in the teenager's room starting at 01:10, as the humidity levels began to climb.
Between 01:10 and 03:10, the sensors recorded the fleeting image of "breath on the glass".
At 02:00, the humidity observed a peak of 46.6 %, dramatically exceeding the expected range of 42.2 % to 44.6 %.
The mysterious moisture lingered in the teenager's room until 03:10.
